text.label: h2 · Information you choose to share
p · When you contact DuooNex by email or WhatsApp, you may share your name
text.value: When you contact DuooNex by email or WhatsApp, you may share your name, contact details, website address, budget and project requirements. Please do not include passwords, payment card details or sensitive records in an initial enquiry.

text.label: p · DuooNex uses project information to understand your request, discuss r
text.value: DuooNex uses project information to understand your request, discuss requirements and prepare a proposal. Any additional handling needed for a project should be described in the relevant agreement.

text.label: p · This website loads externally hosted fonts and includes links to email
text.value: This website loads externally hosted fonts and includes links to email and WhatsApp services. Those providers may process connection or account information under their own terms. The website enquiry form currently does not transmit messages to DuooNex.

text.label: p · Please contact DuooNex to discuss which enquiry or project records are
text.value: Please contact DuooNex to discuss which enquiry or project records are held and any applicable retention requirements. Specific project data-handling arrangements belong in the service agreement.

text.label: p · For questions about personal information, or to request access, correc
text.value: For questions about personal information, or to request access, correction or deletion, email johnsantonyjo@gmail.com. Requests are considered in the context of the information held and applicable obligations.

text.label: p · Using an email or WhatsApp link opens a third-party service. Review th
text.value: Using an email or WhatsApp link opens a third-party service. Review the information in your message before sending it and consult the provider’s privacy information for its handling practices.
